content.text: All three are exactly the right pixel sizes. Final visual check of square and landscape:

All three renders are complete and verified.

**Files produced** (in the working folder, from `card.html` rendered via Playwright):

| File | Size | Layout |
|---|---|---|
| `square.png` | 1080×1080 | Logo + event name top, portrait left of name/role, large 4-line title, hairline footer with date/venue left and pill CTA right |
| `landscape.png` | 1920×1080 | Logo bar top, two columns — title + date/venue + CTA left, large circular portrait with name/role right |
| `story.png` | 1080×1920 | Fully centered stack — logo, big portrait, name/role, centered title, date/venue, centered CTA |

**How defects were caught and fixed during iteration:**
- Footer was floating mid-canvas on square (missing flex chain on the content wrapper) → added `flex:1; display:flex; column` so `margin-top:auto` works.
- CTA rendered with a link underline → reset `a { text-decoration:none }`.
- "Maya Okonkwo-Lindqvist" broke at the hyphen into two lines in landscape → widened the right column to 560px and set `white-space:nowrap` on the name.
- Dead vertical space between title and footer on square and story → enlarged title (72px / 74px), portrait, and spacing; story content is now vertically centered instead of bottom-anchored.

**Checks performed:** card bounding box measured at exactly 1920×1080 (and the PNG headers confirm 1080×1080, 1920×1080, 1080×1920); no element's box escapes the card bounds; no horizontal text clipping (`scrollWidth === clientWidth` on title, name, role, meta, CTA, event name); the title wraps to 3–4 lines at every size; portraits are perfect circles (fixed equal width/height with `object-fit: cover`), and console was clean apart from a harmless missing-favicon 404.
